question: Does the company add anything if I put part of my paycheck aside for when I retire?
expected_answer: Yes. It matches 100% of the first 4% of pay you contribute; you can join after 60 days, and the match vests over 3 years.

question: If I have to stop working for medical reasons late in my pregnancy, how much of my salary is paid?
expected_answer: Short-term disability pays 60% of your pay for up to 12 weeks, after a 7-day waiting period, at no cost to you.

question: How big is the staff discount on the company's own brand of gear?
expected_answer: 40% off Tallowmere Trail products (30% off other regular-price merchandise).

question: A supplier wants to send me an expensive bottle of wine for the holidays. Is there a limit on what I can accept?
expected_answer: Gifts from any one supplier may total up to $75 in a calendar year; decline anything worth more or report it to the Ethics team.

question: Can I report something shady at work without giving my name?
expected_answer: Yes. Reports to the Ethics Line, run by an independent company 24 hours a day at (360) 555-0199 or by web form, can be anonymous.

question: Am I allowed to sell gear I bought cheaply through a brand's staff program?
expected_answer: No. Pro-deal gear is for you and your household only; reselling it is not allowed.

question: Which of your three stores opened most recently?
expected_answer: Ashcombe Junction, which opened in 2021.

question: Are your shops open on Thanksgiving?
expected_answer: No. All stores are closed on Thanksgiving Day, as well as Christmas Day and New Year's Day.

question: If I ask you to erase my personal information, how long will that take?
expected_answer: Within 30 days, after the customer's identity is confirmed; order records needed for tax are kept until their retention period ends.

question: How long do the stores keep their security camera recordings?
expected_answer: 30 days, unless the footage is needed for an incident.

question: I applied for a job and didn't get it. How long will you keep my application?
expected_answer: 1 year after the position closes, or 2 years if you agreed to join the talent pool.

question: I've been here six years. How many vacation days do I get a year?
expected_answer: 20 days a year (5 to 9 years of service).

question: I work at one of the stores. Can I take a week off between Christmas and New Year?
expected_answer: Not normally: store and distribution center employees cannot take vacation between November 20 and January 2 unless their general manager approves an exception.

question: How much per day to borrow a tent that sleeps four?
expected_answer: $35 per day.

question: Do rewards members pay less when they rent equipment?
expected_answer: Yes, Trailhead Rewards members get 10% off all rentals.

question: Will you hold money on my card when I pick up a rented paddleboard?
expected_answer: Yes, a $200 hold on a credit card, released when the gear comes back in good condition; debit cards and cash are not accepted for the deposit.

question: Someone new is joining my team. How early should I order their computer?
expected_answer: At least 5 business days before their start date.

question: I typed my password wrong too many times and now I'm locked out. How do I get back in?
expected_answer: After 10 failed attempts the account locks for 30 minutes and then unlocks automatically; the help desk can unlock it sooner.

question: The card reader at my till stopped working on a busy Saturday. Who should I call?
expected_answer: The store support line at extension 4400; a register that cannot take payments is priority 1 and a technician responds within 15 minutes.

question: How soon do I have to install system updates on my work laptop?
expected_answer: Within 14 days of release, and critical security patches within 72 hours.

question: Can I get my sign-in codes sent by text message?
expected_answer: No. Text message codes are not allowed; use the authenticator app or a hardware security key.

question: How many points do I need before I get money off?
expected_answer: 200 points, which automatically become a $10 reward certificate.

question: I just signed up for the rewards program and my birthday is next week. Will I get the birthday treat this year?
expected_answer: Probably not: the birthday must be in your profile at least 30 days before your birthday month to get the $5 certificate that year.

question: As a new hire, how long do I have to finish the required online courses?
expected_answer: Within 14 days of your start date (security awareness, harassment prevention and Gear 101).

question: What does someone get for being a new employee's buddy?
expected_answer: A $50 gift card when the 60-day buddy pairing ends.

question: My partner is having a baby and I'm not the main caregiver. How much paid leave can I take?
expected_answer: 6 weeks of fully paid leave as a secondary caregiver (each parent chooses; primary caregivers get 16 weeks).

question: How far ahead do I need to warn my manager before I go on leave for a new baby?
expected_answer: At least 30 days before the leave starts, or as soon as possible if the timing is unexpected.

question: When my time off with the baby ends, can I come back on shorter days at first?
expected_answer: Yes, after primary caregiver leave: up to 4 weeks at 60% of your usual hours, on full pay.

question: Will I get a rating at my April review?
expected_answer: No. The April cycle is a check-in without a rating; ratings are given at the annual review in October.

question: When does a raise from my yearly evaluation actually start?
expected_answer: Merit increases take effect on January 1.

question: I bought boots last week and now your website sells them for less. Can I get the difference back?
expected_answer: Yes, if the price drops within 14 days of purchase (from delivery for online orders), the difference is refunded.

question: Will you match a lower price I saw from some random seller on a big shopping site?
expected_answer: No. Prices from third-party sellers on marketplace websites are excluded.

question: If I find three identical stoves cheaper somewhere else, will you match the price on all three?
expected_answer: No, only up to 2 units of the same item per customer.

question: Which days of the week do I need to be in the office?
expected_answer: Tuesdays and Thursdays.

question: Is there any money to help me set up a desk at home?
expected_answer: Yes, a one-time $500 home office stipend after 90 days of employment, plus $40 a month for internet.

question: I'm at the highest level of the rewards program. How long do I have to bring back something I haven't used?
expected_answer: 90 days (Summit tier), instead of the usual 45 days.

question: The sleeping bag I ordered arrived torn. How many days do I have to let you know?
expected_answer: Within 14 days of delivery; send a photo and a replacement is shipped at no cost.

question: I mailed back a jacket last week. When will the money show up on my card?
expected_answer: Within 5 business days after it reaches the distribution center, plus 3 to 10 business days for the card issuer to show it.

question: How much do I have to spend for free delivery?
expected_answer: $75 or more, after discounts and before tax, for free standard shipping.

question: What does it cost to get an order in two days?
expected_answer: $14.95 for expedited shipping.

question: Tracking says my package was dropped off, but it isn't here. Is there a deadline to report it?
expected_answer: Contact customer service within 30 days of the expected delivery date.

question: How much cash should each till have in it when the store opens?
If a snowstorm closes the store, do I still get paid for my shift?
expected_answer: Yes, employees are paid for their scheduled shift if the store closes.

question: My flight home was cancelled and I'll be stuck two extra days. Who do I have to tell?
expected_answer: Your manager, about any change that keeps you away longer than planned; the 24-hour travel assistance line on your itinerary can rebook travel.

question: How long do I have after a business trip to claim my costs back?
expected_answer: Submit the expense report within 30 days of the end of the trip; anything submitted more than 90 days later is not reimbursed.

question: How much do I get back per mile when I drive my own car for work?
expected_answer: $0.67 per mile.

question: My headlamp stopped working after a year and a half. Is it still covered?
expected_answer: Yes, if it is a defect: electronics are covered for 2 years from the purchase date.

question: How much does it cost to fix a jacket zipper that won't close?
expected_answer: $18 for a zipper slider replacement.

question: What's the heaviest thing I'm allowed to lift on my own?
expected_answer: 50 pounds; above that, use a team lift or a cart.

question: I slipped in the stockroom but I'm fine. Do I still need to report it, and by when?
expected_answer: Yes, every injury and near miss must be reported within 24 hours.
